title: WCP capability_query
description: Structural query passed by the matching engine. Discriminates ONLY on the worker's required block. The matcher MUST NOT read class_extension or any informational metadata (agent_class, bond_ref, etc.).

attestation_methods.description: Every method named here MUST be in the worker's required.attestation_methods_supported.

descriptor_types.description: If declared, every type here MUST be in the worker's required.descriptor_types_supported. If the worker has not declared descriptor_types_supported, the query passes (worker accepts all types by default).

certifications.description: Certification ids. Every id here MUST appear in the worker's required.certifications[].id.

location_venue_id.description: If set, MUST equal the worker's required.current_location.venue_id.
